name: Defensive (Combat)
body:
You know how to defend yourself from others.

Prerequisite: Dodge

Benefit: You gain +2 to your combat maneuver defense and gain a +2 dodge bonus to AC. A condition that makes you lose your Dex bonus to AC also makes you lose the benefits of this feat.
